correctness.rationale: The full complex coefficient space reduces exactly to even/odd cosine/sine modes after removal of the unimodular carrier. Both input and symmetric exterior energy forms are diagonal by parity; 1±sin(d)/d>0. Their generalized eigenvalues have deviations from h with opposite signs, proving the sharp global gap-infimum h and the exact equality equation. Strict alternating resonance-function signs at consecutive half-integer π points guarantee infinitely many roots and parity switches. Explicit Taylor expansion proves the small-gap quadratic correction; independent Simpson quadrature and bisection match the formulas at 270 finite checks, not used as infinite proof.
